original_question: Let (A, M) be a regular local ring and let B = A[a/b], where a is in M \ M^2, b is in M^2, and gcd(a, b) = 1 so that B is regular. Under what conditions is the ideal MB a complete intersection in B?

The cited item is the 21-page problem collection "Open problems on open algebraic varieties," and from the accessible record I could not isolate a specific conjecture/proposition/theorem matching your draft; the reference to "Conjecture 1.1, Proposition 1.2, Theorem 1.3" appears inconsistent with this arXiv item.
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the core algebraic setup of a regular local ring (A,M), a birationally generated overring of the form B=A[a/b], the special position of a in M\M^2 and b in M^2, the added regularity assumption on B, and the central issue of whether the extended maximal ideal MB is a complete intersection in B.
missing_details: The paper-faithful target statement could not be verified from the cited arXiv item; as written, the source reference appears mismatched.
It should specify whether A is assumed Noetherian, a domain, and whether B is viewed inside Frac(A).
The condition "gcd(a,b)=1" is not intrinsic for an arbitrary regular local ring unless one explains it as (a,b)=A, or works in a UFD and defines gcd up to units.
It is not stated whether B is local; if not, one should say whether the question concerns the ideal MB in B globally or after localizing at a prime/maximal ideal of B lying over M.
The meaning of "MB is a complete intersection" should be made explicit: usually that MB is generated by ht(MB) elements forming a B-regular sequence.
The draft does not say whether one is asking for a characterization, a necessary-and-sufficient criterion, or a universal yes/no statement.
Any hidden dimension restrictions on A are omitted.

If the regularity of B is assumed rather than derived, the question should not mix in extra conditions whose only purpose is to imply regularity unless that implication is part of the source statement.
refined_question: Let (A,M) be a Noetherian regular local domain with fraction field K, let a in M\M^2 and b in M^2 satisfy (a,b)=A, and set B=A[a/b] as a subring of K. Assume that B is regular. Under these hypotheses, for which choices of A, a, and b is the extended ideal MB a complete-intersection ideal of B, i.e. generated by ht(MB) elements forming a B-regular sequence?
